free_tier.stated: Chinese GPU cloud (JuChiYun) publishing per-hour rates per zone with visible card availability: RTX 5090 32GB CNY 2.99/hr on 16 cores, 60 GB RAM and 300 GB SSD; RTX A6000 48GB CNY 2.85/hr on 12 cores, 86 GB RAM and 350 GB SSD; A100 40GB CNY 2.80/hr; RTX 4090 24GB CNY 2.20/hr; A30 24GB CNY 2.19/hr. At USD 1 = CNY 6.6743 that is USD 0.448, USD 0.427, USD 0.420, USD 0.330 and USD 0.328 per GPU-hour. Each row states the zone and how many cards that zone has free, for example a zone labelled as having at most two cards available.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The trial credit is unquantified, so it composes with nothing until an account exists; the A100 40GB row at USD 0.42/hr is the cheapest 40 GB A100 hour seen among evaluated providers, below Jarvislabs at USD 0.89.

limits.value: The SMS registration step fails first: no account exists without a Chinese mobile number, and the new-user credit is only claimable after that step.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is documented as a mobile number plus an SMS code: the register page shows the steps translated as 'verify mobile number', then the mobile number field and the SMS code field.

evidence.proved: translated from the Chinese page, each rate marked as billed by the hour: RTX 5090 32GB CNY 2.99 on 16 cores and 60GB RAM; RTX A6000 48GB CNY 2.85; A100 40GB CNY 2.80; RTX 4090 24GB CNY 2.20; A30 24GB CNY 2.19
each row carries a per-zone free-card count, translated as at most one card available and at most two cards available, which is a supply figure rather than an account cap
translated from the register page: a new-user trial credit is given on registering, and the form steps are verify mobile number, mobile number, SMS code, set password
RTX 4090 24GB is CNY 2.20 per hour, marked as billed by the hour; the page lists no H100, L40S or L4 and no A100 other than the 40GB card, and states no minimum bill
A100 40GB is CNY 2.80 per hour, billed by the hour
RTX 5090 32GB is CNY 2.99 per hour, billed by the hour
RTX 4090 is CNY 2.20 per hour, marked as billed by the hour

record.notes: Rates sit above AutoDL and Featurize for the same cards, so this is a supply-and-zone story rather than a price story: the zone labels and per-zone card counts are the part that other Chinese retailers do not publish. The size of the new-user credit is not stated on the page and was not established; it would need an account. Conversion uses the same 2026-10-22 rate as the other Chinese records in this batch.
